envelope.description: Team policy reader, anchor finder and sighting store onto the tools

body.title: Team policy reader, anchor finder and sighting store onto the tools
body.summary: Move policyReader (probeGitRepo, probeRemote, probeRemoteHead, resolveRev, readAt, scanForPolicy), findAnchor (git_rev_parse isShallow and git_path_history) and resolveRepoIdentity onto git-calls; PolicyReader and findAnchor become async. Results and failure texts equal the old ones on the same repository.
acceptanceChecks: team-policy-registry.test.ts runs the reader and the anchor finder through the registry on real temporary repositories (not a repo, no remote, detached HEAD, shallow, valid and invalid policy)
team-policy-parity.test.ts shows the new results equal the old functions' results on the same repositories
no runGit call remains in policy-reader.ts, anchor-finder.ts and sighting-store.ts

tests.name: team-policy-registry.test.ts: policyReader and findAnchor run through the registry on not a repo, no remote, detached HEAD, shallow, valid policy and invalid policy
team-policy-parity.test.ts: policyReader and findAnchor equal the old functions on the same repositories
